_failedMessages.details: When a message fails to receive, it is stored here to allow for retries.

_gasLimits.details: When sending, this is used to determine the gas limit for the message.

_trustedRemoteEVM.details: When sending, this is used to determine the initial recipient of a bridging message.         When receiving, this is used to validate the sender of the message.         As the zero address can be a trusted remote, the `isSet` flag is used to determine if the trusted remote is set.

_trustedRemoteSVM.details: When sending, this is used to determine the initial recipient of a bridging message.         When receiving, this is used to validate the sender of the message.         As the zero address can be a trusted remote, the `isSet` flag is used to determine if the trusted remote is set.
